about.title: Who we are?
about.p1: We are a dedicated team of experienced Quran teachers committed to educating our Muslim community about the knowledge of the Holy Quran. We have been working with students of all ages (especially children), teaching them how to recite the Arabic text of the Holy Book from the Alif Baa to reciting with tune!
about.p2: We generally start taking children as young as 4 years, and because we have both male and female teachers, we are able to teach both genders privately or in group sessions (if available).
about.p3: Our classes are conducted primarily online via Skype or Zoom. Please contact us to check availability.
about.imageAlt: Learn Al Quran Online BD teachers and students

courses.title: Our Courses
